title: Fiona the hippo dies after ingesting visitor's hat
summary: The Cincinnati Zoo says Fiona the hippo, who became a social media darling after surviving her premature birth, has died, days after ingesting a visitor's hat.

image.caption: Fiona the hippo, seen here in her enclosure at the Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden on Jan. 23, 2020, has died after ingesting a visitor's hat. (John Minchillo/The Associated Press)

blocks.text: The Cincinnati Zoo says Fiona the hippo, who became a social media darling after surviving her premature birth, has died, days after ingesting a visitor's hat.
The 9-year-old hippopotamus became a social media darling after surviving her premature birth

Fiona, the hippo whose premature birth and fight for survival at the Cincinnati Zoo turned her into a global sensation nearly a decade ago, died Thursday from complications after ingesting a visitor's hat that was accidentally flung into her enclosure.

"It is with extreme sadness that we share with you the devastating news that Fiona did not make it after multiple attempts from our amazing vets and keeper team to help her through what ended up being a medical emergency," the zoo said in a statement.
The zoo said Monday that the nine-year-old hippo was undergoing care around the clock after swallowing the hat more than a week ago.
